headline: 1,463 hospitalised in 24 hours as dengue claims 3 more lives
summary: Total deaths rise to 133 and cases reach 46,938 as the virus continues to spread across the country.
details: At least three dengue patients died and 1,463 others were hospitalised within a 24-hour period ending at 8:00 am today.
The fatalities were reported in Dhaka North City Corporation, Mymensingh, and Rangpur divisions.
With these latest figures, the total number of dengue deaths has risen to 133, while the total number of cases has reached 46,938.
Currently, 3,252 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at various hospitals across the country.

headline_marked: Savar SI killing: [[Three more accused]] placed on five-day remand
headline: Savar SI killing: Three more accused placed on five-day remand
summary: Three more suspects in the killing of Special Branch SI Altaf Hossain have been placed on a five-day remand for interrogation. The victim was beaten to death after intervening in an argument.
details: Three more suspects in the killing of Special Branch Sub-Inspector (SI) Altaf Hossain have been placed on a five-day remand by a Dhaka court. The court ordered the remand of Rakib Mia, Sabbir Ahmed, and Md Wasim after police requested their custody for investigation.

SI Altaf Hossain, 58, was beaten to death on September 5 in Savar's Aminbazar area. The incident began when he intervened in an argument over parking an auto-rickshaw. The suspects allegedly attacked him with rods, pipes, and hammers.

The victim sought refuge in his son's business establishment, Grand Fashion, but the assailants followed and attacked him there. His son, Ariful Islam, was also injured while trying to protect his father. SI Hossain was declared dead at the hospital.

A murder case was filed by the victim's wife, Mosammat Shiuli Parveen, against 15 named individuals and several unnamed accomplices. So far, 14 people have been arrested in connection with the murder.

The investigating officer stated that the remand is necessary for a thorough investigation, recovery of weapons, and identification of all involved individuals. The defense lawyers argued against the remand, but the court granted the police's request.
